task.id, task.task_name AS taskName, task.task_type AS taskType, content.message_type AS messageType, runtime.is_enabled AS enabled, runtime.run_status AS runStatus, task.is_short_link_enabled AS shortLinkEnabled, task.version, content.promotion_link AS promotionLink, task.data_package_id AS dataPackageId, task.data_package_name_snapshot AS dataPackageName, task.account_filter AS accountFilterJson, task.target_country_iso2s_snapshot AS targetCountryIso2sJson, task.task_planned_end_at AS plannedEndAt, task.task_interval_minutes AS cycleIntervalMinutes, task.created_at AS createdAt, runtime.recipient_total AS recipientTotal, runtime.send_total AS sendTotal, runtime.success_num AS successNum, runtime.delivered_num AS deliveredNum, runtime.read_num AS readNum, runtime.fail_num AS failedNum, runtime.fail_404_num AS unregisteredNum, runtime.used_account_count AS usedAccountCount, runtime.invalid_account_count AS invalidAccountCount, runtime.click_uv_num AS clickUvNum, runtime.click_total AS clickTotal, runtime.actual_concurrency AS actualConcurrency, runtime.execution_duration_sec AS executionDurationSec, runtime.active_since_at AS activeSinceAt, runtime.metrics_updated_at AS metricsUpdatedAt

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hyperlink_task (task_name, task_type, start_mode, task_delay_minutes, task_planned_end_at, task_interval_minutes, data_package_id, data_package_generation, data_package_name_snapshot, target_country_iso2s_snapshot, source_template_id, source_template_version, hyperlink_strategy_id, account_filter, max_use_account, concurrent_num, account_max_send_num, account_send_concurrency, msg_interval_min_ms, msg_interval_max_ms, is_short_link_enabled, version, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskName}, #{taskType}, #{startMode}, #{taskDelayMinutes}, #{taskPlannedEndAt}, #{taskIntervalMinutes}, #{dataPackageId}, #{dataPackageGeneration}, #{dataPackageNameSnapshot}, #{targetCountryIso2sSnapshot}, #{sourceTemplateId}, #{sourceTemplateVersion}, #{hyperlinkStrategyId}, #{accountFilter}, #{maxUseAccount}, #{concurrentNum}, #{accountMaxSendNum}, #{accountSendConcurrency}, #{msgIntervalMinMs}, #{msgIntervalMaxMs}, #{shortLinkEnabled}, #{version}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.task_name, t.task_type, t.start_mode, t.task_delay_minutes, t.task_planned_end_at, t.task_interval_minutes, t.data_package_id, t.data_package_name_snapshot, t.account_filter, t.max_use_account, t.concurrent_num, t.account_max_send_num, t.msg_interval_min_ms, t.msg_interval_max_ms, t.is_short_link_enabled, t.version, t.created_at, t.updated_at, c.message_schema_version, c.message_type, c.title, c.content, c.link_description, c.promotion_link, c.buttons, c.card_text, c.link_preview_asset_id, c.body_main_asset_id, r.is_enabled AS enabled, r.run_status, r.provision_status FROM hyperlink_task t INNER JOIN hyperlink_task_content c ON c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.hyperlink_task_id = t.id INNER JOIN hyperlink_task_runtime r ON r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.hyperlink_task_id = t.id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE hyperlink_task SET task_name=#{entity.taskName}, task_type=#{entity.taskType}, start_mode=#{entity.startMode}, task_delay_minutes=#{entity.taskDelayMinutes}, task_planned_end_at=#{entity.taskPlannedEndAt}, task_interval_minutes=#{entity.taskIntervalMinutes}, data_package_id=#{entity.dataPackageId}, data_package_generation=#{entity.dataPackageGeneration}, data_package_name_snapshot=#{entity.dataPackageNameSnapshot}, target_country_iso2s_snapshot=#{entity.targetCountryIso2sSnapshot}, account_filter=#{entity.accountFilter}, max_use_account=#{entity.maxUseAccount}, concurrent_num=#{entity.concurrentNum}, account_max_send_num=#{entity.accountMaxSendNum}, msg_interval_min_ms=#{entity.msgIntervalMinMs}, msg_interval_max_ms=#{entity.msgIntervalMaxMs}, is_short_link_enabled=#{entity.shortLinkEnabled}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{entity.updatedAt} WHERE id=#{entity.id} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
UPDATE hyperlink_task SET version=version+1, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
